result: If I could change the world in one way, I’d aim to guarantee universal access to clean water and basic sanitation. Water is essential for health, education, and economic opportunity—without it, disease, poverty, and time lost to collecting water trap people, especially women and girls. Providing reliable water and sanitation would dramatically reduce mortality, boost learning, free up people to work and innovate, and strengthen communities against climate shocks. Achieving it would require investing in resilient infrastructure, good governance, affordable services, plus outreach to reach remote and marginalized communities.
